about: External course websites the collector reads (read only, GET). start: the first pages. follow: URL prefixes whose pages and files are read when a read page links them; links outside them stay links. Videos are never downloaded. unlock (optional): pages that show links only with an access token in the URL fragment (CryptoJS AES); the token is read at run time from a stored item that contains token_in_items_like and is never stored in the repository. Example entry: { "id": "db", "name": "Database course", "moodle_course": 12345, "start": ["https://course.example.org/"], "follow": ["https://course.example.org/slides/"] }. Add your sites to the list and deploy.
